newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokai Kogyo board members mull court application.
newsitem.headline: Tokai Kogyo board members mull court application.

text.p: Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd said on Friday that its board had begun meeting at 1 p.m. (0400 GMT) to discuss ways of restructuring, including applying for court protection under Japanese bankruptcy laws, due its financial difficulties.
A spokesman for the construction company said the meeting was still taking place.
The spokesman declined to comment further.
Japanese media reported on Friday afternoon that the construction company was preparing to apply for court protection from creditors under Japanese law.
Jiji new agency, quoting unnamed sources, reported that the company had debts totalling 520 billion yen.
